answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dawn of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The island is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the delta. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
